tools.name: catalog
tools.description: Inspect this connection’s scope, tools and access policy. With no arguments returns the usual catalog. On the general or economy connection, optionally supply report_countries (1–10 World Bank codes) for a FREE live preview of the optional paid country comparison: population/GDP/inflation by default

tools.name: get_record
tools.description: Get an unexpired record with provenance and its explicit verification level. Source/schema validation is not independent factual verification.

tools.name: get_evidence
tools.description: Retrieve the source JSON snapshot and SHA-256 digest for a currently available record. The digest proves snapshot integrity, not factual truth.
